name: Schedule Task
description: Schedule a future task or reminder for yourself. The message comes back to you as an event at the chosen time (you must be a live/autonomous agent to receive it). Use in_s for relative times, at for absolute ones, repeat_s to make it recurring.

message.description: What to do when the event fires, written so your future self understands it

in_s.description: Fire after this many seconds from now (e.g. 3600 = in one hour)

at.description: Fire at this ISO timestamp (e.g. '2026-07-29T08:00'). Alternative to in_s, and only for a wall-clock time the user actually named: it must be in the future, and you do not reliably know the current time — prefer in_s.

repeat_s.description: Repeat every this many seconds (e.g. 86400 = daily). 0 or omitted = one-shot.
